# Standpoint Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:StandpointTenure`](gmeow-StandpointTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StandpointTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)

The reified, time-scoped fact that a standpoint held a particular position over an interval — recognition granted in 2008 and withdrawn in 2030 is an opened-then-closed tenure, never a deletion ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). Use only when the adoption / withdrawal of the position is itself worth modelling; the common case is a bare [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) annotation. Carries its standpoint-time interval via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) (temporal module). A [`StandpointTenure`](gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) generates a [`gmeow:standpointClaim`](../properties/gmeow-standpointClaim.md) observation. The tenure is the time-scoped fact; the claim is the observation of that fact. The [`tenureStandpoint`](../properties/gmeow-tenureStandpoint.md) maps to the claim's vantage; the [`tenurePosition`](../properties/gmeow-tenurePosition.md) maps to the claim's [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:StandpointTenure`](gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
